gen-dafont-nordic-fs-gambetta: Ancient and blunt, with letters spaced like far-apart brush dabs. Gambetta, a classic serif, does the quiet reading work with its gently shifting strokes, while Nordic carries the powerful, weathered voice in one uniform line.
gen-dafont-nordic-lora: Lora, a classic serif, has a broad, welcoming c and hairlines that thin only modestly at the curves. But across a page it would feel literary and unhurried, a foil to the closed, uniformly bold letters of Nordic.
gen-dafont-nordic-noto-serif: Noto Serif brings a prominent x-height and the mild variation of a dip pen used gently, a universal, literary serif. Nordic supplies unbroken, ancient weight up top; the serif softens it below.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-gambetta: Nulshock stretches its letters out with wide tracking and a steady, unshaded outline. Gambetta, a text serif, then pulls things back in, with wide channels into each counter and strokes that shift gently.
gen-dafont-nulshock-lora: Nulshock spreads its letters wide, with a steady, unshaded outline. That stretched, technical look is best for bold display moments, while Lora, a text serif, handles quiet reading with a broad, welcoming c.
gen-dafont-nulshock-noto-serif: Nulshock draws its diagonals and horizontals at matching weight, in wide, stretched tracking. And Noto Serif, a text serif, moves at a gentler pace, its mild stroke variation and prominent x-height easing the eye along.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-crimson-pro: Round and commanding, Oldtimer shapes its letters like open parentheses, with no swell on any downstroke. Crimson Pro, a text serif, reads refined and snug, line after line.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-neco: Round, stern and swell-free, Oldtimer looks like a row of open parentheses. But Neco, a serif, lets its strokes swell gently from hairline to stem, close enough in spirit to feel related.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-recia: Oldtimer draws hollow, glass-tube letters at a constant thickness, round like open parentheses. Recia, a classic serif, carries the detail with subtle pen-like modulation in its bowls, so Oldtimer earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-newsreader: Newsreader, a text serif, reads with open jaws on its curves and stems just slightly heavier than the hairlines. Page after page it feels refined and authoritative, a quiet foil to Oldtimer.
